title: Ostomy Supply Program Service Recovery by Reason for a No-Charge Shipment
content:
An Ostomy Supply Program reason service-recovery part follows why Larkfield sent the shipment at no charge, when it corrects an expedited shipping charge posted in error against that shipment. The reason is the replacement reason recorded on the program's most recent shipment sent expedited at no charge.

| Why the shipment was sent at no charge | Reason part |
|---|---|
| A replacement for a package lost in transit | USD 10.00 (the larger reason recovery) |
| A replacement for a package damaged in transit | USD 5.00 (the smaller reason recovery) |
| Any other no-charge shipment | Nothing |

This part adds to the whole charge.

**Cases (hypothetical).** A replacement for a package lost in transit and shipped expedited at no charge: USD 10.00. A replacement for a package damaged in transit: USD 5.00. An expedite sent at no charge to make up for a delay Larkfield caused, with no replacement reason: nothing.
